name: io.github.imagekit-developer/api-mcp
title: ImageKit
description: Upload, search, organize, and transform images, videos, and files in your ImageKit media library.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGEKIT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your ImageKit private API key (starts with `private_`). Found in the ImageKit dashboard under Developer > API Keys.

environmentVariables.name: IMAGEKIT_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Your ImageKit webhook secret (starts with `whsec_`). Only required if you verify webhook signatures.
